data.text:
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) announced the reopening of the EDSA-Ortigas Interchange early Monday, April 27, following a temporary closure due to a bus fire that occurred on the southbound lane of the EDSA Carousel on Friday night.

“As of  a.m., EDSA-Ortigas flyover going to San Juan is now passable for light vehicles, following a final assessment conducted by the Department of Public Works and Highways,” the MMDA said in its advisory.

Sa pamamagitan ng programang ito, matututunan ng mga batang kalahok ang fire prevention and life safety tips, interactive fire station tour, at may libreng meet-and-greet pa kasama ang mga real-life firefighter. 🤩❤️

Kaya halina't samahan ang inyong mga bulilit sa isang thrilling at unforgettable na summer experience! 🧯💪🏼
